_readme: QUALITATIVE per-chain dossier — the intelligence that filings and store counts do NOT carry:
a chain's HISTORY, its most POPULAR ITEMS, its FLAGSHIP / best-known OUTLETS, and loose NOTES.
A Pro-tier dimension that sits beside the measured numbers (store counts, financial_anchors,
opening pace). PRO ONLY — never written to the public map/data.
PROVENANCE, same posture as the rest of the project. Every item carries `as_of` + `source`
(a `source_url` where there is one) and a `confidence`: 'high' for a primary filing / company
statement, 'medium' for reputable press, 'low' for a single weak mention. NEVER fabricate; an
unknown field is simply absent. First-party / official / filings / reputable press / licensed
sources only — NO review/delivery/aggregator platforms (Dianping, Meituan, 窄门餐眼, …).
SHAPE. brands[<chain_id>] may hold any of:
popular_items   [ {name, note?, as_of, source, source_url?, confidence}, … ]
flagship_outlets[ {name, city?, note?, as_of, source, source_url?, confidence}, … ]
Measured figures (avg store area, orders/day, AUV, store counts) do NOT live here — they go to
the `financial_anchors` table (measured) and `china_stores.json` (counts). This file is prose.

history.text: Founded 1997 in Zhengzhou, Henan by Zhang Hongchao (张红超) as a cold-drinks and shaved-ice stand; grew into an ultra-low-price bubble-tea and soft-serve franchise and by 2025 was the world's largest F&B chain by store count. Listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (2097.HK) in March 2025.
history.source: Mixue Group HKEX listing / global offering prospectus (2097.HK, 2025)

popular_items.name: Fresh ice cream cone (冰淇淋)
popular_items.note: The brand's best-known draw — a ~¥2-4 soft-serve cone.
popular_items.source: Mixue prospectus product mix and reputable press

popular_items.name: Lemonade (柠檬水)
popular_items.note: ~¥4 fresh lemonade, a flagship high-volume SKU.

notes.text: The 'Snow King' (雪王) mascot is central to the brand's marketing and recognition.

history.text: Auntea Jenny (沪上阿姨, 'Shanghai Auntie') is a Shanghai mid-priced freshly-made tea chain founded in 2013, known for grain-forward '五谷' milk teas and fruit teas. It franchises aggressively — ~9,000+ stores, overwhelmingly franchised — and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (2589.HK) in December 2024, after which it accelerated an overseas push (Malaysia first, then Australia, the UK, South Korea and Indonesia).
history.source: Auntea Jenny IPO prospectus / HKEX listing (2589.HK, Dec 2024)

popular_items.name: Grain milk tea (五谷/杂粮奶茶)
popular_items.note: The brand's signature grain-forward milk tea — its best-known positioning.
popular_items.source: Auntea Jenny brand positioning / reputable press

popular_items.name: Royal Fruit Tea (XL)
popular_items.note: A viral oversized fruit tea (watermelon/orange/mango/lemon) reported at the Seoul launch; served with a spork to eat the fruit.
popular_items.source: Korean food blog (chingumobile free board), weak single source

notes.text: Trades under its Chinese identity 沪上阿姨 ('Shanghai Auntie') across its overseas markets; romanized 'Hu Shang Ayi'.
